name: Native navigation with brief sensory blackouts
question: Does making spatial memory useful change what Grid and PGC LSTMs learn, and does predictive input improve the stability and behavioral usefulness of that memory?

design.unit: native environment frames; each decision spans 4 frames

native_features_preserved: navigation reward and native goal respawn
task.observation_rule: Everything stays visible until the first goal discovery. Every discovery/respawn starts 15 visible observations. Thereafter alternate 15 visible observations with a private-random blackout of ceil(D/2)..D decisions. D increases linearly in integer steps to 60 over 200M frames. Episode termination clears all memory and restores vision until the new first discovery.
task.blackout: Set the rendered RGB and all 512 current spatial-code entries to zero before policy input. The environment still renders and draws native image noise. The stored goal, previous action and reward remain available.
task.native_control: task_max_gap=0; native inputs are unchanged at every step.

budget.rule: Freeze cohort before scientific outcomes. Use technical throughput only to decide feasibility. Never replace or select seeds based on reward or ring results. Report every attempted run, including interruptions. Exact resume only, with unchanged source/protocol/config/runtime/GPU model. No run is called 1B before its saved counter is exactly 1B.

evaluation.primary_outcome: mean native episode navigation score, summarized independently for each training seed
evaluation.primary_comparison: First, paired PGC-minus-Grid navigation score in blackout-trained models tested under blackout. Second, the difference in that PGC-minus-Grid contrast between blackout-trained and native-trained models.
evaluation.memory_test: Erase both LSTM hidden and cell states at the start of each blackout, or at every blackout step. Apply the same scheduled erasures in a fully visible control. Compare the extra behavioral cost of erasure during blackout.
evaluation.predictive_input_test: Replace only current predictive entries with the same ordinary grid code in PGC models; preserve the native stored goal. Grid models receive an identical sham. During zero-input periods this replacement itself has no effect.
evaluation.coupling: Same initial layouts, native noise and action uniforms across variants. First discoveries must match. Later paths, goals and visibility resets can diverge; record actual exposure and reset counts.
evaluation.statistics: Training seed is the independent unit. Report all four paired seed effects and uncertainty; four pairs cannot support a two-sided exact sign-flip p below 0.125. Episodes are repeated measurements, not independent trained networks.

mechanism_followup.pca: Show raw pooled activity spectra and the same spectra after removing each episode average; report between-episode variance. Keep these distinct from dynamical evidence.
mechanism_followup.held_out_validation: Fit simple angular readouts and population summaries on separate episodes, then evaluate held-out layouts/goals and memory periods. Include shuffled-angle and matched-native controls.
ring_requirements: a continuous closed family in the full hidden-plus-cell state supported by held-out native task states
memory persists with spatial/visual cues absent
small off-family perturbations recover while nearby angular memories remain distinguishable
mechanism_followup.analysis_rule: A round projection alone is insufficient. Follow full-state recovery, angular drift, cue repair and behavioral effects. Publish negative and failed tests alongside positive ones. Freeze numerical assay settings before examining final-model outcomes.
predictive_stabilization_requirements: predictive cue removal and restoration change recovery or drift in matched states
the corresponding intervention changes navigation in the predicted direction
mechanism_followup.autonomous_dynamics: For autonomous-ring assays, use one complete input held constant over time and identical across compared initial states and perturbations, including goal, image, current code, previous action and previous reward. A repeated time-varying input sequence is labeled driven/periodic. Ordinary blind navigation includes action/reward feedback and is analyzed separately as task-driven dynamics.
mechanism_followup.interpretation: Report ring structure independently of predictive stabilization. A ring can exist without a PGC advantage; absence of a predictive advantage does not redefine ring detection.

literature_rationale.use: Training recurrent networks on angular integration/memory can produce slow ring-like invariant structure; not evidence that this native RL task must do so.
Navigation training conditions that require retention can change learned memory dynamics.
Visual correction and cue-free persistence motivate matched cue removal/restoration tests.

technical_preflight_revision.reason: The L4 TF32 benchmark showed a maximum actor/replay value discrepancy of 0.00015195, exceeding the fixed tolerance. Disable TF32 for all scientific runs and repeat the CUDA preflight; do not relax the comparison tolerance.
technical_preflight_revision.equivalent_optimization: Disable redundant Categorical argument validation; exact probabilities, sampling, gradients and RNG equivalence tested separately. Reward, optimizer and hyperparameters are unchanged.
